Brief History

Lakhimpur Commerce College was established on 4 th September, 1972 with the objective of imparting
commerce education to aspiring students of all sections of the society. The college is affiliated to
Dibrugarh University, Assam. It is a co-educational institution. In the year 1993 the college also
introduced Arts Stream up to Degree level to meet the demands of the students and the public.
The college has entered fifty glorious years of its existence this year and to mark the Golden Jubilee
celebration it has planned to introduce a Knowledge Based Industry, to introduce Post Graduate courses and
Vocational courses with a view to introducing and implementing the New Education Policy-2020.


Vision of the College

The college believes in democratic and secular values and tries to accommodate students from all sections of
society with the principle of providing equal opportunity to all for availing higher education. All
stakeholders pledge to work and endeavour to see Lakhimpur Commerce College grow as an institution of
prominence in the realm of higher education.


Mission of the College

The college is committed to:

    To produce good, efficient, responsible, self reliant, forward looking and patriotic youth
     force/citizens with scientific temper who will contribute to the knowledge economy.
    The college will impart skill based and vocational education to develop self-reliant youth and
     assure employment guarantee.
    Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education as per Sustainable Development Goal-4 (SDG-4)
     mandated by UN and implemented by the Government of India.
    Promote lifelong learning opportunities for all sections of students irrespective of caste, creed, sex,
     religion and socio-economic status.
    Achieve global status in the area of education and leadership by imparting and leading the students.
    Produce high quality and skilled students who are globally employable in the competitive market.
    Use and develop rich talents and resources of the nation for the benefit of the society, country and
     world.
    Enable students to have knowledge on fundamental rights, democratic modes, human values and
     rights, secular ideals and develop in them the qualities of leadership to cope up in the global
     environment.
 Location of the College:
The College is located at the heart of North Lakhimpur town. Its location is easily accessible for its
proximity to the official residences of the Deputy Commissioner, Lakhimpur, Superintendent of Police,
District and Sessions’ Judge, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur Sadar Police Station and institutions like Post
Graduate Training College, District Library, Gandhi Park etc. The college also has a second campus at
Chukulibhoria with around 26 Bighas of land approximately.


COLLEGE OFFICE


The college office is located on the First Floor of the RCC-1 (Main Building) within the campus. It is the
nerve centre of the institute which supports its governance structure and plays a key role in the smooth
running of the college administration.


WORKING HOURS OF THE COLLEGE OFFICE:


Monday to Saturday (except holidays): 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.


TEACHING DEPARTMENTS OF THE COLLEGE


The college has Departments of Accountancy, Banking, Management, Commerce, Statistics,
Commercial Law and Commercial Arithmetic for Commerce stream.
It also has Departments of Political Science, Education, Sociology and Mathematics for Arts stream.
The Assamese, Economics, English, and Hindi and are common Departments for both Commerce and
Arts Streams.

 ADMISSION CRITERIA FOR B.A. & B. COM. PROGRAMME


A student who has passed the Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) in Commerce/Arts from the Assam
Higher Secondary Education Council or equivalent examination (10+2) or from any other State Higher
Secondary Education Council/Board recognized as such by Act/Law, shall be eligible for admission into the
1st Semester Class of the Under Graduate courses in Commerce and Arts. Any student who has passed the
Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) in Science/Arts with Mathematics/Statistics as one of the subjects in
the Assam Higher Secondary Council or an equivalent examination or from any other State Higher
Secondary Education Council/Board, shall also be eligible for admission into the UG Programme. The
College allows admissions to only to Honours courses in its UG Programmes.

The Reservation Policy of the Government of India/the State Government is duly followed in
selection for admission.

Admission Criteria to M.Com Courses:
The B.Com passed students who have cleared the Dibrugarh University Post Graduate Entrance Test
(DUPGET) shall be eligible for admission into the 1st Semester Class of the M.Com. courses.
The Application Forms are invited through online mode only. The applicant may visit the college website
https://lccollege.edu.in where the online Application Form is available. The last date for submission of
 online application will be notified in the college website. The applicant may also apply through the online
admission link https://lccadmission.online/register
      The merit list of provisionally selected candidates on the basis of DUPGET Score shall be notified
       in college website https://lccollege.edu.in & on notice board of the College.
      The provisionally selected candidates shall have to appear before the admission committee on the
       date of admission along with necessary testimonials for their admission into M.Com Courses.
      The Selection and Admission of all applicants shall be purely provisional and subject to fulfillment
       of requisite norms of qualifying examinations and other relevant criteria.
       The intake capacity of the M.Com course is 20 (twenty) in each Semester
Fees Structure:
The session fees of M.Com Course (under CBCS regular mode) for the different semesters which will be
paid at the time of admission are:
   a) M.Com 1st Semester                              -     Rs. 13,000/-
   b) M.Com 2nd Semester                              -     Rs. 10,100/-
   c) M.Com 3rd Semester                              -     Rs. 13,000/-
   d) M.Com 4th Semester                              -     Rs. 10,100/


Admission Requirement:
The original documents of all the submitted photocopies of testimonials are to be produced before the
admission committee on the date of admission along with the following documents in original.
      A print copy of the online application submitted along with the photo copies of all relevant
       testimonials.
      DUPGET 2024 Scorecard.
      Three (3) nos. of recent passport size coloured photographs.
      Transfer/Migration Certificate issued from appropriate authority, if any.

ADMISSION CRITERIA FOR H.S. PROGRAMME:
A student who has successfully passed the H.S. L.C./10th standard Final Examination of
SEBA/CBSE/ICSE or equivalent examination with good percentage of marks and possesses a good moral
character with good conduct is eligible to apply for admission to H.S. Programme. The College
reserves the right to fix the cut off marks for issue of admission form and for granting admission.

ADMISSION RULES FOR ADMISSION TO HIGHER SECONDARY, B.A. & B. COM
PROGRAMMES:

ONLINE MODE ADMISSION:

From this year only online mode for admission will be entertained to Higher Secondary, B.A. and B. Com
Programmes. For Higher Secondary admission to the college should be applied through the Darpan link
of AHSEC. A downloaded copy of the filled online application form along with photo

Copies of MARKSHEET, PASS CERTIFICATE, CASTE CERTIFICATE has to be submitted to the
college office on or fore the last date of submission. All original documents must be produced at the time
of admission only.
N.B: ADMISSION TO ANY PROGRAMME OF STUDY OF THE COLLEGE CANNOT BE
CLAIMED AS A MATTER OF RIGHT
ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS
The following original documents are to be shown at the time of Admission. Original documents is to be
submitted to the college office at the time of admission:
• Pass certificate.
• Mark sheet of the H.S.L.C/A.H.S.E.C. or equivalent examination.
• Admit card of the examination last appeared.
• Caste certificate /Reservation, where necessary.
• Three (3) nos. of recent passport size coloured photographs.
• Certificates of Sports, Cultural and Extra-Curricular activities of District / State/National
• Level importance
• Transfer/Migration Certificate issued from appropriate authority, if any.
NB: Economically poor students/applicants for availing free admissions (if the Govt. of Assam provides
so) must have to produce Income Certificate (from competent authority) of their parents' Annual income.
Students from families holding BPL Certificate/ Card can produce only BPL Certificate/Card for this
purpose.
 SELECTION PROCEEDURE FOR ADMISSION:

Admission to a particular Course/Stream/programme is allowed on the basis of academic merit, good
conduct and character of a student/applicant. The college authority has the power to exercise its discretion
for reasons it deem fit and proper in selection and admission matters.

Merit List is prepared according to the seat capacity of the college for admission to H.S. 1st Year, B.A.
and B. Com. 1st Semester classes and accordingly admission is given.

RESERVATION FOR ADMISSION:

The college follows Reservation Rules/Guidelines of the Govt. of India/Govt. of Assam while considering
admission on Reservation to Higher Secondary and Degree Courses.
N.B: THE COLLEGE RESERVES THE RIGHT TO REFUSE ADMISSION TO ANY
APPLICANT/CANDIDATE / STUDENT FOR REASONS IT DEEM FIT AND PROPER.

SELECTION FOR MAJORS COURSE:

Students opting for MAJOR in a particular subject in B.A. and B. Com. Programmes, must have to
clearly mention it in the application form. Selection for allowing Honours shall be made by the concerned
teaching Department on the basis of merit.

ATTENDANCE BY LATEST SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY:

Minimum 80% attendance in class is compulsory for the students of H.S., B.A. and B. Com. programes.
If a Degree student fails to attain minimum 80% attendance, he/she will be deemed non-collegiate and
will have to pay penalty as per University rules at the time of filling up forms for examinations. The
college has its own software for recording daily class attendance. The software is also utilized for giving
Home Assignments and maintaining records of sessional examinations and courses covered in the class. It
serves purpose of Teachers’ and Students’ Diary.

The college emphasizes regular attendance of students in class. Skipping remaining classes after attending
one or two classes in a day will be viewed seriously.

STUDENT IDENTITY CARD:

A student must come to college with college ID-Card. He/she must wear ID-Card on all occasions such as
College Freshers’ Social, Students’ Union Election, Annual College Week, during examinations, college
inspection and assessment days and on such other important functions, programmes etc.

STUDENT UNIFORM:

Students are required to wear uniform compulsorily as follows:
Students coming to college not wearing college uniform will not be allowed entry. The College Vigilance
Cell will regularly inspect adherence to college uniform code by students. The students should come to
the college in neat and clean uniform.
 UNIFORM CODE FOR BOYS:

White formal Shirt with college emblem and Dark Grey formal Pant and Black sweater (in winter). No
tight-fitting shirt and pant as Uniform is allowed under any circumstances. A student cannot wear pants
below waist line. No bottom narrow pant is allowed. No tie for uniform.

UNIFORM CODE FOR GIRLS:

White Mekhela Chadar with Red border on Chadar and White Blouse with college emblem or White
Salwar Kurta with college emblem and Jaipuri Printed cotton Dupatta (Red- White Spot) and Black
Sweater (in winter). Leggings and Patiala pyjamas are not allowed.

N.B. The college emblem is available in all garment shops of North Lakhimpur

Rules for maintenance of Discipline and preservation of college property
Students must abide by the rules and regulations of the college and maintain discipline in and around the
college premises and contribute towards creating a healthy, harmonious, decent and congenial atmosphere
of teaching and learning and good campus life.

 A Student must attend classes regularly.
 A Student must behave properly with the teachers, the non-teaching staff, the library and the canteen
staff.
 Students should come to the college in college Uniform. They should not wear such dress which is
not in keeping with the discipline, decorum and dignity of the college and student life.
 Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited in and around the college campus. Disciplinary action as
per law will be taken for encouraging and indulging in Ragging of any type.
 Students are required to keep their bicycles and two-wheelers on the space specified/provided by the
college.
 Bicycles and two-wheelers under no circumstances be kept here and there, in front of classrooms,
sub-ways and passages to class rooms, library, office buildings, canteen etc.

 Students under no circumstances should create any noise pollution in and around the college campus.
 Students must help maintain a green campus.
 Students should not spit on the walls, floors, pillars or doors of the college buildings/class rooms,
canteen, common rooms and in the corners of staircases.
 Students must help maintain a clean campus/swachha campus.
 Students must not temper with college electric fittings, furniture, gadgets, computers, library books,
journals, newspapers and other properties.
 Students must not harm, destroy, steal away decorative plants and flowers from the college.
 Students can participate in the students’ union election on democratic line but they shall in no way be
patronized by any political party, group politics or organization. Disciplinary action will be taken against
any student detected indulging in such activities which vitiate the academic atmosphere and general
environment of the college.
 Every student is required to extend his active co-operation in making successful all co-curricular,
extracurricular activities/programmes/functions organized by the college. Any attempt on the part of a
student to mar the decency and decorum of the programme will be viewed seriously.
 Use of Mobile phone is not allowed in the college campus.
 Smoking, Chewing Gutkha and use of any tobacco product/narcotics/drugs and alcohol inside the
college campus is strictly prohibited.
 Each student should go through the college prospectus to know detail information and rules, maintain
class routine.
 Each student should regularly look at the college notice board to secure information.
  Noise pollution/disturbance by students through use of high sound/ultra sound generating motor
cycles is strictly prohibited. Students having such type of motor bikes will have to off the engine/motion
at the college campus Gate before making entry and also while departing from college, they will have to
take out such two-wheelers up to the Gate of the college in off-engine position/without start and then
start/on the engine of the motor bikes with view to prevent noise pollution in the campus.
 Students cannot sit on/take rest on parked Motor cycles and scooties inside the college campus and
just in front of the college campus gate as this mars the decency and decorum of educational environment
of the college.
 Students cannot indulge in any act of damage/loss to the parked vehicles and motor bikes of the
teachers, college staffs, visiting guests and fellow students.
 Students cannot misbehave with the College Gate Keeper, Chowkidar and any personnel engaged in
College work.
 Students cannot stand/ gather in groups with two-wheelers at any location of the college approach
road between the college campus gate and the college main gate as this causes traffic jam/congestion.
 Students cannot stand/gather in groups in front of college main gate and block the traffic movement
on grounds of their own safety and security and that of the public.
 A Student must have to join/participate in all functions/programmes of the college.
 A student have must to appear at all internal/sessional examinations conducted by the college and
submit Home Assignments and Project Assignments within time period stipulated by respective Teaching
Departments for award of internal assessment marks.

USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA:

Students cannot use social media outlets like Facebook, Whatsapp, Twitter, Instagram, Tumbler,
Messenger and other such modes to defame the college, any other student/s, members of the teaching and
the non-teaching staffs and the Governing Body. Any kind of negative, destructive, harmful, defamatory
and anti-college activity through the use of social media will be seriously viewed and deemed as
punishable offence.

APPLICATION FOR LEAVE OF ABSENCE

If a student fails to attend classes on any genuine ground, he/she must have to submit application praying
for Leave of absence duly signed by him/her and the parents/guardians.
ANTI-RAGGING RULES IN COLLEGE
The college is committed to curbing the menace of ragging in its campus and immediate surrounding as
per the judgement of Honourable Supreme Court of India and the regulations of the UGC. The college
has a Vigilance and Anti-Ragging committee to take steps in this regard.
The Anti Ragging policy of Lakhimpur Commerce College is formed in compliance with the UGC
“Regulation on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009” available on
the UGC website i.e. www.ugc.ac.in.

OBJECTIVE

1. To eliminate the menace of ragging from the college campus.
2. To prohibit and prevent any act which can be categorised as ragging by strictly imposing the
regulations.
3. To sensitise both the parents and students about the evil of ragging through submission of
undertaking by each student in every academic session.
4. To adopt measures like mentoring and counseling as well as installation of CCTV cameras to prevent
ragging in the campus.
5. Disseminate the idea of a ragging free campus through talks, workshops, plays and other creative
ways.
 PUNISHABLE ACTS THAT CONSTITUTE RAGGING:

1. Abetment to ragging
2. Physical, verbal or psychological abuse targeted at another student (fresher or otherwise)
3. Any act of indiscipline or rowdy behaviour that can cause alarm, annoyance or fear in fresher or any
other student.
4. Any act of bullying, mocking, insulting, humiliation or exclusion that causes physical, mental or
psychological injury to another student.
5. Any act of exploiting the service of fresher by senior students.

6.   Any act of sexual comment or exploitation.
7.   Any act of unlawful assembly and rioting while ragging.
8.   All other acts that is included in the definition of ragging.

MEASURES FOE PREVENTION/ PROHIBITION OF RAGGING IN THE INSTITUTION:

1. Lakhimpur Commerce College strictly observes the policy of anti – ragging as per the “Regulation on
Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009”. Ragging is recognised as a
cognizable offence and steps are taken to strictly prohibit and prevent it in all forms in the campus.
2. The Anti – Ragging Policy of the college is reflected in the Prospectus published every year to
sensitize the candidates seeking admission and their wards regarding the menace of ragging. Ever
candidate has to submit the duly filled up affidavit in English, Hindi or any regional language
understanding the provision of anti-ragging during the time of admission.
3. Anti-Ragging Policy of the college is prominently displayed on the Notice Boards, as Posters, in all
departments, hostel, office and library and at places known to be vulnerable to occurrences of ragging
incidents.
4. The authority and the faculty members take active role in counseling and arranging Induction and
Orientation programmes to create awareness among the students against the menace of ragging.

5. Measures will be taken to develop a healthy relationship between freshers and old students through
organising Interaction Programme.
6. The institution has formed Anti-Ragging Committee, Vigilance Committee and Disciplinary Action
Committee to prevent ragging and other acts of indiscipline and take action wherever necessary.
7. Freshers are encouraged to report any incident of ragging faced by them or any other fellow student.

ADMINSTRATIVE ACTIONS TAKEN IN THE EVENT OF RAGGING:

If any incident of ragging is reported or brought to the notice of the authority or the Anti-Ragging
Committee the following administrative process of action as per the UGC regulation would be adopted:
1. The Anti-Ragging Committee of the college will take an appropriate decision looking at the gravity
of the offence depending on facts of incident and accordingly punish the guilty.

2. Depending on the nature of the incident and gravity of the situation the following punishment might
be meted out to the offender:
i. Temporary or permanent suspension from the institution.
ii. Withholding or withdrawing any kind of scholarship or financial aid to the guilty.
iii. Debarring from appearing in examination.
iv. Withholding results.
v. Debarring from contesting in Union Body Election or participating in any competition.
vi. Imposing fine.
An appeal against the judgment passed by the Anti-Ragging Committee may be lodged by the accused to
the principal of the college.

SAMARTH PORTAL:

The Samarth Student Portal is a centralized digital platform initiated by India's Ministry of Education to
automate and streamline operations for universities and Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). It offers
services like online admissions, profile management, fee payments, and academic record tracking, aiming
to improve efficiency through a digital framework.


KEY ASPECTS OF SAMARTH PORTAL:

Purpose: To provide a comprehensive digital framework for university planning and management.
Admissions & Registration: Used for student admissions, such as the Assam State Higher Education
Admission Portal.
Student Services: Offers a centralized hub to access academic information, digital IDs, and program
details.
Access: Students can register and log in using their enrollment/roll number and a password, usually with
an OTP-based secure setup.
Regional Use: Extensively used for state-level university admissions, including for undergraduate
programs in Assam.
Developed by: The project was developed by the University of Delhi in collaboration with the Ministry of
Education (formerly MHRD)

IGNOU STUDY CENTRE:

The college has an IGNOU Study Centre (Code 0413) with as many as 42 (forty two) programmes in Post
Graduation, Graduation, Diploma and Certificate Courses including Master of Business Administration
(MBA).

K.K.H.S.O.U. STUDY CENTRE:

The college has a Study Centre of The Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University with some special
and value based subjects like PGDCA, PGDHM, BBA.

DIBRUGARH UNIERSITY DISTANCE EDUCATION CONTACT CENTRE:

The college has a Dibrugarh University Contact Centre of Distance Education for Post Graduate
programmes in eight subjects: Assamese, English, Political Science, Education,
Economics, Sociology, Mathematics and Commerce.

NAAC ASSESSMENT AND ACCREDITATION:

National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), Bangalore carried out assessment of the college
in the year 2023 and accredited B Grade for second cycle of assessment.
 COLLEGE NOTICE BOARD:

All office orders, decisions, rules, instruction are notified on the college Notice Boards placed at different
places in the college premises. A student can access necessary information from the Notice Board.
Sticking of any bills on the notice boards or elsewhere inside the college premises by students will be
treated as an offence. Students cannot write anything on the notices given on the notice boards.
Students /Office bearers of the Students' Union/any outside Institution/Organisation seeking to circulate
any information or notice or to paste up a notice or bulletin/advertisement must have to obtain prior
approval of the Principal of the college. Removing/Erasing, tearing out any notice/information material
from notice boards is treated as an act offence of serious nature and such offence attracts punishment
which the authority deem fit and proper.
No student should remove any notice/notices from the notice boards which will prevent his/her fellow
students from getting the required information.
